## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Uppannattika* ("Triad on the Arisen") constitutes the eighteenth chapter of the first main division of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the canonical Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Like the other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to investigate the phenomena classified under the *uppannattika* triad from the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*).

SuttaCentral records one modern translation in a single language [SuttaCentral]. No Curated parallels are listed on SuttaCentral, reflecting the distinctive structural role of the canonical *Paṭṭhāna* within the Pali tradition [SuttaCentral]. However, computational text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus reveals extensive structural and formulaic parallels across the Pali canon, identifying 3,916 shared passages across 63 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The vast majority of these internal parallels occur within other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, exhibiting substantial verbatim overlap with the *Kusalattika* (Patthana 1.2), the *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10), the *Cūḷantaraduka* (Patthana 2.2), the *Vitakkattika* (Patthana 1.7), and the *Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 2.1) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus detects segment correspondences with several non-Pali scholastic works, including Sanskrit texts such as Ghoṣaka's *Abhidharmāmṛta* and Harivarman's *Satyasiddhiśāstra*, alongside Tibetan translations of the *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* and the *Āryasaṃdhinirmocanasūtravyākhyāna* [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
